# CoreUI Vue.js documentation

> CoreUI for Vue.js is a UI component library written in TypeScript and ready for your next Vue.js project.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/introduction.md): CoreUI for Vue.js is UI Component library written in TypeScript, and ready for your next Vue.js project. Learn how to include CoreUI for Vue.js in your project.
- [Install](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/install.md): Install CoreUI for Vue.js with a package manager, add the required peer dependencies, and import the styles from the compiled CSS or the Sass source.
- [Browsers & devices](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/browsers-devices.md): Learn about the browsers and devices, from modern to old, that are supported by CoreUI for Vue, including known quirks and bugs for each.
- [Accessibility](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/accessibility.md): A brief overview of CoreUI for Vue features and limitations for the creation of accessible content.
- [RTL](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/rtl.md): Learn how to enable support for right-to-left text in CoreUI for Vue across our layout, components, and utilities.

## AI Tools

- [LLMs.txt](/vue/docs/6.x/ai-tools/llms-txt.md): LLM-optimized documentation endpoints for CoreUI for Vue — llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and a Markdown version of every page.
- [MCP Server](/vue/docs/6.x/ai-tools/mcp.md): Bring the CoreUI for Vue documentation into your AI coding assistant with the @coreui/docs-mcp Model Context Protocol server.
- [Agent Skills](/vue/docs/6.x/ai-tools/skills.md): Step-by-step playbooks that teach AI coding agents to install CoreUI for Vue and migrate to v6, shipped in the @coreui/vue-pro package.

## Guides

- [Nuxt](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/nuxt.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components in your Nuxt project.
- [Vite](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/vite.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components in a Vue project built with Vite.
- [Vue Router](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/vue-router.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components in a routed Vue project scaffolded with create-vue.
- [Astro](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/astro.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components as Vue islands in an Astro project.
- [Tailwind CSS](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/tailwind.md): How to run CoreUI for Vue components next to Tailwind's utilities: one cascade layer order, no second reset, and Tailwind reading our design tokens.

## Customize

- [Overview](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/overview.md): Learn how to theme, customize, and extend CoreUI for Vue with Sass, a boatload of global options, an expansive color system, and more.
- [Architecture](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/architecture.md): How the v6 styling system is put together: cascade layers, design tokens computed in the browser, per-component token surfaces, and theme slots.
- [Sass](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/sass.md): Utilize our source Sass files to take advantage of variables, maps, mixins, and functions to help you build faster and customize your project.
- [Options](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/options.md): Quickly customize CoreUI for Vue with built-in variables to easily toggle global CSS preferences for controlling style and behavior.
- [Color](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/color.md): CoreUI for Vue is supported by an extensive color system that themes our styles and components. This enables more comprehensive customization and extension for any project.
- [Theme](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/theme.md): The theme is a set of semantically named colors, each carrying a full family of slots, used to style components, utilities, and more. It is configurable via Sass or CSS and responds to color modes.
- [Color modes](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/color-modes.md): CoreUI for Vue supports color modes, or themes. Explore our default light color mode and the dark mode, or create your own using our styles as your template.
- [Components](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/components.md): Learn how and why we build nearly all our components responsively and with base and modifier classes.
- [CSS Variables](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/css-variables.md): Use CoreUI's CSS custom properties for fast and forward-looking design and development.
- [Transitions](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/transitions.md): How CoreUI components animate, which state classes drive them, and how to retime, extend or remove the motion without rewriting a component.
- [Optimize](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/optimize.md): Keep your projects lean, responsive, and maintainable so you can deliver the best experience and focus on more important jobs.

## Layout

- [Breakpoints](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/breakpoints.md): Breakpoints are the triggers in CoreUI for Vue.js for how your layout responsive changes across device or viewport sizes.
- [Containers](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/containers.md): Containers are a fundamental building block of CoreUI for Vue.js that contain, pad, and align your content within a given device or viewport.
- [Grid](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/grid.md): Use our powerful mobile-first flexbox grid to build layouts of all shapes and sizes thanks to a twelve column system, six default responsive tiers, Sass variables and mixins, and dozens of predefined classes.
- [Columns](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/columns.md): Learn how to modify columns with a handful of options for alignment, ordering, and offsetting thanks to our flexbox grid system.
- [Gutters](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/gutters.md): Gutters are the padding between your columns, used to responsively space and align content in the CoreUI for Vue.js grid system.
- [Z-index](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/z-index.md): While not a part of the CoreUI for Vue.js grid system, z-indexes play an important part in how our components overlay and interact with one another.
- [CSS Grid](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/css-grid.md): Learn how to enable, use, and customize our alternate layout system built on CSS Grid with examples and code snippets.

## Content

- [Reboot](/vue/docs/6.x/content/reboot.md): Reboot, a collection of element-specific CSS changes in a single file, kickstart CoreUI for Vue to provide an elegant, consistent, and simple baseline to build upon.

## Forms

- [Autocomplete](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/autocomplete.md): Build powerful Vue Autocomplete components with dynamic search, dropdown suggestions, and external data integration. The ultimate Vue.js Autocomplete solution for modern web applications.
- [Checkbox](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/checkbox.md): Create consistent cross-browser and cross-device checkboxes with our Vue checkbox components.
- [Chip Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/chip-input.md): Vue Chip Input component for CoreUI helps you create tag-like multi-value inputs for skills, categories, or recipients with keyboard support, selection, and form integration.
- [Combobox](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/combobox.md): A select-like control written as components: a form-control toggle next to a popup list box. CCombobox runs the open state, the selection, the keyboard and form submission, and leaves the content of every option to you.
- [Date Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/date-input.md): Create Vue date fields with a section-based input mask. Users type the day, month, and year in separate sections with automatic navigation and validation — like the native date input, but with full control over the format.
- [Date Picker](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/date-picker.md): The Vue Date Picker Component is an essential tool for any Vue-based application that requires date selection functionality.
- [Date Range Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/date-range-input.md): Create a Vue start and end date field in one frame. Both ends use the section-based mask of the date input, and the range is validated as a whole.
- [Date Range Picker](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/date-range-picker.md): The Vue Date Range Picker Component is an essential tool for any Vue-based application that requires date range selection functionality.
- [Field](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/field.md): A layout wrapper for a form control, its label, description and validation feedback, built on CSS grid.
- [Floating labels](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/floating-labels.md): Vue floating label component. Create beautifully simple form labels that float over your input fields.
- [Form Control Group](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/form-control-group.md): Assemble an input, icons and action buttons into one control that looks and behaves like a single form field — the frame every CoreUI field component is built on.
- [Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/input.md): Vue input components. Give textual form `<input>`s an upgrade with custom styles, sizing, focus states, validation, and more.
- [Input group](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/input-group.md): Easily extend form controls by adding text, buttons, or button groups on either side of textual inputs, custom selects, and custom file inputs.
- [Multi Select](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/multi-select.md): Customize the native <select>s with a powerful Vue Multi Select component that changes the element’s initial appearance and brings some new functionalities.
- [Number Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/number-input.md): A Vue number field with accessible increment and decrement buttons, with min, max and step handled by the browser.
- [OTP Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/one-time-password-input.md): Create secure and user-friendly Vue.js one-time password input fields with automatic navigation, paste support, validation, and customizable options for modern authentication flows.
- [Password Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/password-input.md): A fully featured Vue password input component with Bootstrap styling. Includes show/hide visibility toggle, validation states, sizing, and full accessibility support.
- [Password Strength](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/password-strength.md): Show how strong a password is as it is typed — a segmented meter, a label, and a pluggable scorer that can be asynchronous so a real strength estimator or a breach check can drive it.
- [Radio](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/radio.md): Create consistent cross-browser and cross-device radios with our Vue radio component.
- [Range](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/range.md): Vue range component. Use our custom range inputs for consistent cross-browser styling and built-in customization.
- [Range Slider](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/range-slider.md): Enhance your forms with our customizable Vue Range Slider component for advanced range selection.
- [Rating](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/rating.md): A Vue star rating component allows users to rate and provide feedback on content or products by selecting a specified number of stars, typically ranging from one to five, representing their level of satisfaction or preference.
- [Select](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/select.md): Vue select component. Customize the native `<select>`s with custom CSS that changes the element's initial appearance.
- [Stepper](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/stepper.md): Build multi-step forms and wizards easily with the Vue Stepper component. Create advanced Vue form flows with custom indicators, validation, and flexible layouts using Vue 3.
- [Switch](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/switch.md): Create consistent cross-browser and cross-device switch component.
- [Textarea](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/textarea.md): Vue textarea components. Give textual form `<textarea>`s an upgrade with custom styles, sizing, focus states, validation, and more.
- [Time Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/time-input.md): Create Vue time fields with a section-based input mask. Users type the hour, minutes, and seconds in separate sections with automatic navigation and validation — like the native time input, but with full control over the format.
- [Time Picker](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/time-picker.md): The Vue Time Picker Component offers a seamless way for users to select time values in any Vue-based application.
- [Layout](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/layout.md): Give your forms some structure—from inline to horizontal to custom grid implementations—with our form layout options.
- [Validation](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/validation.md): Provide valuable, actionable feedback to your users with HTML5 form validation, via browser default behaviors or custom styles and JavaScript.

## Components

- [Accordion](/vue/docs/6.x/components/accordion.md): Build vertically collapsing accordions in combination with our Vue Accordion component.
- [Alert](/vue/docs/6.x/components/alert.md): Vue alert component gives contextual feedback information for common user operations. The alert component is delivered with a bunch of usable and adjustable alert messages.
- [Avatar](/vue/docs/6.x/components/avatar.md): The Vue Avatar component is used to display circular user profile pictures. Vue avatars can portray people or objects and support images, icons, or letters.
- [Badge](/vue/docs/6.x/components/badge.md): Vue badge component is small count and labeling component.
- [Breadcrumb](/vue/docs/6.x/components/breadcrumb.md): Vue breadcrumb navigation component which indicates the current location within a navigational hierarchy that automatically adds separators.
- [Button](/vue/docs/6.x/components/button.md): Vue button component for actions in tables, forms, cards, and more. CoreUI for Vue.js provides various styles, states, and size. Ready to use and easy to customize.
- [Button Group](/vue/docs/6.x/components/button-group.md): Vue button group component allows to group a series of buttons and power them with JavaScript.
- [Calendar](/vue/docs/6.x/components/calendar.md): The Vue Calendar Component is a versatile, customizable tool for creating responsive calendars in Vue, supporting day, month, and year selection, and global locales.
- [Callout](/vue/docs/6.x/components/callout.md): Vue callout component provides presentation of content in a visually distinct manner. Includes a heading, icon and typically text-based content.
- [Card](/vue/docs/6.x/components/card.md): Vue card component provides a flexible and extensible container for displaying content. Card is delivered with a bunch of variants and options.
- [Carousel](/vue/docs/6.x/components/carousel.md): Vue carousel is a slideshow component for cycling through elements—images or slides of text—like a carousel.
- [Chart](/vue/docs/6.x/components/chart.md): Vue wrapper for Chart.js 3.0, the most popular charting library.
- [Chip](/vue/docs/6.x/components/chip.md): Vue chip component for CoreUI lets you build compact, interactive labels, tags, filters, and selections with icons, avatars, remove buttons, and keyboard support.
- [Chip Set](/vue/docs/6.x/components/chip-set.md): Vue Chip Set component groups chips into an accessible, keyboard-navigable container with single or multiple selection.
- [Close Button](/vue/docs/6.x/components/close-button.md): A generic close button component for dismissing content like modals and alerts.
- [Collapse](/vue/docs/6.x/components/collapse.md): Vue collapse component toggles the visibility of content across your project with a few classes and some scripts. Useful for a large amount of content.
- [Dialog](/vue/docs/6.x/components/dialog.md): Vue Dialog component built on the native <dialog> element — top layer rendering, blurred native backdrop, focus trapping, and accessible semantics out of the box.
- [Drawer](/vue/docs/6.x/components/drawer.md): Vue Drawer component built on the native <dialog> element — a floating side panel with top layer rendering, a native backdrop and accessible semantics out of the box.
- [Context Menu](/vue/docs/6.x/components/context-menu.md): Vue Context Menu opens a menu at the pointer on right-click or the keyboard's Menu key - built on the Menu component with the same items, submenus, keyboard navigation and dismissal.
- [Dropdown](/vue/docs/6.x/components/dropdown.md): Vue dropdown component allows you to toggle contextual overlays for displaying lists, links, and more html elements.
- [Focus Trap](/vue/docs/6.x/components/focus-trap.md): Vue Focus Trap component ensures keyboard navigation stays within a designated container element. Essential for creating accessible modal dialogs, dropdown menus, and overlay components that comply with WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
- [Footer](/vue/docs/6.x/components/footer.md): Vue footer component is an additional navigation used for displaying general information that a user might want to access from any page within your site. It is a place to display boilerplate text about the site, company info, copyrights, links to a contact form, sitemap, FAQ and other such resources.
- [Header](/vue/docs/6.x/components/header.md): Documentation and examples for the Header powerful, responsive navigation header. Includes support for branding, links, dropdowns, and more.
- [Icon](/vue/docs/6.x/components/icon.md): Vue icons library is a great resource for Vue developers, who can use its customizable SVG icons in their applications. It offers an extensive library of icons to choose from, which can be easily inserted into projects with just a few lines of code. Not only that, but users are also able to customize the appearance of these icons by setting various props on them. This provides developers with an efficient and flexible way to integrate useful graphical elements into their web pages without doing any extra work.
- [Image](/vue/docs/6.x/components/image.md): Vue image component with responsive behavior (so it's never become larger than their parent element) and special styles.
- [List Box](/vue/docs/6.x/components/list-box.md): A keyboard-driven list of values built on the ARIA listbox pattern: single, multiple or no selection, sections, descriptions, links, an empty state and an aria-activedescendant mode that keeps the focus in your own input.
- [List Group](/vue/docs/6.x/components/list-group.md): Vue List Group component allows displaying a series of content. Learn how to use Vue list group to build complex list structure on your website.
- [Loading Button](/vue/docs/6.x/components/loading-button.md): Vue loading buttons are interactive elements that provide visual feedback to users, indicating that an action is being processed. These buttons typically display a loading spinner or animation.
- [Menu](/vue/docs/6.x/components/menu.md): Contextual overlays for lists, links and actions: one panel component with submenus, responsive placement and viewport-aware flipping.
- [Modal](/vue/docs/6.x/components/modal.md): Vue Modal component offers a lightweight, multi-purpose popup to add dialogs to yours. Learn how to customize CoreUI Vue modal components easily. Multiple examples and tutorial.
- [Nav](/vue/docs/6.x/components/navs-tabs.md): Documentation and examples for how to use CoreUI's included Vue navigation components.
- [Navbar](/vue/docs/6.x/components/navbar.md): Documentation and examples for the Vue navbar powerful, responsive navigation header component. Includes support for branding, links, dropdowns, and more.
- [Offcanvas](/vue/docs/6.x/components/offcanvas.md): Vue alert component allows build hidden sidebars into your project for navigation, shopping carts.
- [Pagination](/vue/docs/6.x/components/pagination.md): Documentation and examples for showing pagination to indicate a series of related content exists across multiple pages.
- [Placeholder](/vue/docs/6.x/components/placeholder.md): Use loading Vue placeholders for your components or pages to indicate something may still be loading.
- [Popover](/vue/docs/6.x/components/popover.md): Documentation and examples for adding Vue popovers, like those found in iOS, to any element on your site.
- [Progress](/vue/docs/6.x/components/progress.md): Documentation and examples for using Vue progress bars featuring support for stacked bars, animated backgrounds, and text labels.
- [Scrollspy](/vue/docs/6.x/components/scrollspy.md): Automatically update the navigation based on scroll position to indicate which section is currently active in the viewport.
- [Search Button](/vue/docs/6.x/components/search-button.md): Vue search button component for keyboard-aware search entry points, command palettes, modals, and offcanvas panels.
- [Sidebar](/vue/docs/6.x/components/sidebar.md): Vue Sidebar is a powerful and customizable responsive navigation component for any type of vertical navigation. Bootstrap Sidebar come with built-in support for branding, navigation, and more.
- [Smart Pagination](/vue/docs/6.x/components/smart-pagination.md): Documentation and examples for showing smart pagination to indicate a series of related content exists across multiple pages.
- [Smart Table](/vue/docs/6.x/components/smart-table.md): A Vue Smart Table provides a full set of features for displaying and manipulating tabular data. It allows you to easily create dynamic and interactive tables with features such as sorting, filtering, pagination, and searching. Vue Smart Table Component (DataTables) makes it easy to work with large datasets, and it is widely used in a variety of applications, including web-based applications, e-commerce sites, and more.
- [Spinner](/vue/docs/6.x/components/spinner.md): Indicate the loading state of a component or page with CoreUI spinners, built entirely with HTML, CSS, and no JavaScript.
- [Tab](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tabs.md): The CoreUI Vue Tabs component provides a flexible and accessible way to create tabbed navigation in your application. It supports various styles and configurations to meet different design requirements.
- [Table](/vue/docs/6.x/components/table.md): Documentation and examples for opt-in styling of tables.
- [Toast](/vue/docs/6.x/components/toast.md): Push notifications to your visitors with a toast, a lightweight and easily customizable alert message.
- [Toaster](/vue/docs/6.x/components/toaster.md): Create toast notifications from anywhere in a Vue app with the CoreUI Toaster: a store keyed by id with add, update, close and promise, a placed container, a visible-toasts limit and screen-reader priority.
- [Tooltip](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tooltip.md): Documentation and examples for adding Vue Tooltips.
- [Transfer](/vue/docs/6.x/components/transfer.md): Two lists side by side and four buttons that move options between them — the selection or everything at once: a select-all header with a counter, an optional per-list search, a one-way mode and an announcement of every move.
- [Virtual Scroller](/vue/docs/6.x/components/virtual-scroller.md): A virtual scroller is a UI element that allows users to scroll through a list of items without requiring the entire list to be loaded into memory at once. This can be particularly useful for lists that are very large or that contain a lot of data, as it allows the user to view and interact with a subset of the list while the rest of the data is loaded in the background.

## Helpers

- [Backdrop](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/backdrop.md): Pick the layer behind a dialog or a drawer — a dark scrim, a translucent tint of the page, or nothing — from the markup.
- [Clearfix](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/clearfix.md): Quickly and easily clear floated content within a container by adding a clearfix utility.
- [Color & background](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/color-background.md): Set a background color with contrasting foreground color.
- [Focus ring](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/focus-ring.md): Utility classes that allows you to add and modify custom focus ring styles to elements and components.
- [Hover lift](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/hover-lift.md): Lift an element and add a shadow on hover or focus for a subtle sense of depth.
- [Icon link](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/icon-link.md): Quickly create stylized hyperlinks with CoreUI Icons or other icons.
- [Position](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/position.md): Use these helpers for quickly configuring the position of an element.
- [Stacks](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/stacks.md): Shorthand helpers that build on top of our flexbox utilities to make component layout faster and easier than ever.
- [Stretched link](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/stretched-link.md): Make any HTML element or CoreUI for Vue component clickable by "stretching" a nested link via CSS.
- [Text truncation](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/text-truncation.md): Truncate long strings of text with an ellipsis.
- [Vertical rule](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/vertical-rule.md): Use the custom vertical rule helper to create vertical dividers like the `<hr>` element.
- [Visually hidden](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/visually-hidden.md): Use these helpers to visually hide elements but keep them accessible to assistive technologies.

## Utilities

- [API](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/api.md): The utility API is a Sass-based tool to generate utility classes.
- [Aspect ratio](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/aspect-ratio.md): Make an element hold an aspect ratio of your choosing. Perfect for responsively handling video or slideshow embeds based on the width of the parent.
- [Align content](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/align-content.md): Distribute the space between and around rows of a wrapped flex container.
- [Align items](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/align-items.md): Align items along the cross axis, in both flexbox and grid containers.
- [Align self](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/align-self.md): Override the container’s cross-axis alignment for a single item.
- [Background](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/background.md): Convey meaning through `background-color` and add decoration with gradients.
- [Border](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/border.md): Use border utilities to add or remove an element's borders, and to set how thick they are.
- [Border color](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/border-color.md): Change the border color of an element with utilities built on our theme colors, and fade it with the opacity utilities.
- [Border radius](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/border-radius.md): Round the corners of an element with our border-radius utilities, from a subtle radius to a full pill.
- [Color scheme](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/color-scheme.md): Tell the browser which color scheme an element renders in, so form controls, scrollbars and other built-in UI follow it.
- [Colors](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/colors.md): Convey meaning through `color` with a handful of color utility classes. Includes support for styling links with hover states, too.
- [Container queries](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/container-queries.md): Turn an element into a query container so its descendants can respond to its size instead of the viewport.
- [Display property](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/display.md): Quickly and responsively toggle the display value of components and more with our display utilities. Includes support for some of the more common values, as well as some extras for controlling display when printing.
- [Divide](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/divide.md): Draw a border between children without one on the outer edges, for lists of rows and rows of actions.
- [Flex](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/flex.md): Quickly manage the layout, alignment, and sizing of grid columns, navigation, components, and more with a full suite of responsive flexbox utilities. For more complex implementations, custom CSS may be necessary.
- [Float](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/float.md): Toggle floats on any element, across any breakpoint, using our responsive float utilities.
- [Font family](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-family.md): Switch a selection to our monospace font stack.
- [Font size](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-size.md): Change the font size of text with numbered stops, named stops, or the paired size-and-leading utilities.
- [Font style](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-style.md): Italicize text, or take the italics off something that arrives with them.
- [Font weight](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-weight.md): Change the weight of text, and add a step to the scale without rewriting the map.
- [Gap](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/gap.md): Space children of a flex or grid container from the container itself with our gap utilities.
- [Grid](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/grid.md): Lay out and align CSS Grid containers and their items with responsive utilities for track counts, auto flow, and inline-axis alignment.
- [Height](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/height.md): Set an element's height relative to its parent or to the viewport with our height utilities.
- [Justify content](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/justify-content.md): Align flex items along the main axis of a flex container.
- [Justify items](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/justify-items.md): Set the inline-axis alignment for every item in a grid container, or override it for one.
- [Line height](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/line-height.md): Change the line height of text with our line-height utilities.
- [Link](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/link.md): Link utilities are used to stylize your anchors to adjust their color, opacity, underline offset, underline color, and more.
- [Margin](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/margin.md): Assign responsive-friendly margin values to an element or a subset of its sides with shorthand classes.
- [Motion](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/motion.md): Remove the transition from a single element with motion utilities.
- [Object fit](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/object-fit.md): Use the object fit utilities to modify how the content of a [replaced element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Replaced_element), such as an `<img>` or `<video>`, should be resized to fit its container.
- [Opacity](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/opacity.md): Control the opacity of elements.
- [Overflow](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/overflow.md): Use these shorthand utilities for quickly configuring how content overflows an element.
- [Padding](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/padding.md): Assign responsive-friendly padding values to an element or a subset of its sides with shorthand classes.
- [Place items](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/place-items.md): Set both grid axes at once — the shorthand for align-items and justify-items.
- [Pointer events](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/pointer-events.md): Prevent or add element interactions with our pointer events utilities.
- [Position](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/position.md): Use these shorthand utilities for quickly configuring the position of an element.
- [Shadows](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/shadows.md): Add or remove shadows to elements with box-shadow utilities.
- [Space between](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/space.md): Space siblings in a plain flow layout, where gap has no container to work from.
- [Text alignment](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-alignment.md): Realign text with our responsive text alignment utilities.
- [Text decoration](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-decoration.md): Underline, strike through, or remove the decoration from text.
- [Text transform](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-transform.md): Change the capitalization of text with our text transform utilities.
- [Text wrapping](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-wrapping.md): Control how text wraps, overflows, and breaks inside its container.
- [Theme](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/theme.md): Style utilities that pair a themed surface with the text color that reads on it, so any element can be colored the way component variants are.
- [User select](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/user-select.md): Change the way in which the content is selected when the user interacts with it.
- [Vertical alignment](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/vertical-align.md): Easily change the vertical alignment of inline, inline-block, inline-table, and table cell elements.
- [Visibility](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/visibility.md): Control the visibility of elements, without modifying their display, with visibility utilities.
- [Width](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/width.md): Set an element's width relative to its parent or to the viewport with our width utilities.
- [Z-index](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/z-index.md): Use our low-level `z-index` utilities to quickly change the stack level of an element or component.
